\section{\texttt{ToolRunRecord}}
\label{class:feedback_intelligence_agent.schemas.ToolRunRecord}\label{schema:ToolRunRecord}\index{Classes!ToolRunRecord}

Metadata about one tool invocation performed during an agent run.
\apifield{Inherits}\texttt{BaseModel}
\apifield{Fields}
\begin{arglist}
  \item[\texttt{tool\_\allowbreak{}name}] \texttt{str}, required
  \item[\texttt{status}] \texttt{Literal['ok',\allowbreak{} 'refused',\allowbreak{} 'error']\allowbreak{}}, required
  \item[\texttt{summary}] \texttt{str}, required
  \item[\texttt{output}] \texttt{dict[str,\allowbreak{} Any]\allowbreak{}}, default \texttt{dict()\allowbreak{}}
\end{arglist}
\apifield{Details}\texttt{status} is \texttt{ok} when the tool ran successfully, \texttt{refused} when an unknown or unavailable tool was requested, and \texttt{error} when a registered tool failed. \texttt{output} carries the structured tool output so API and CLI consumers can inspect exactly what the tool produced.
